title: Oscar Winner Jamie Foxx Reacts To Lakers LeBron James Passing Kareem Abdul-Jabbar In Scoring
htmlContent:
Actor and musician Jamie Foxx recently commented on LeBron James becoming the all-time leading scorer in NBA history.

LeBron James surpassed Kareem Abdul Jabbar as the league's all-time leading scorer on January 25, 2023, during a game against the Oklahoma City Thunder. The achievement has been widely celebrated by fans and players alike, with many taking to social media to share their thoughts on James' impressive accomplishment.

Foxx, who is known to be a huge fan of LeBron James, took to Instagram to share his thoughts on the event. He posted a video of LeBron's historic shot, along with a caption that read:

King James, LeBron congrats baby you are number one. The number one scorer in the league, the first guy to do it from Akon, Ohio. From your biggest fan despite what Shannon Sharpe says, "I'm your number one fan and I just want to say congratulations. You did it was just class, such style and I know your family happy for you, Ohio is happy for you, and are all happy for you. King James [Salute]," said Foxx.

The Academy Award-winning actor has been a vocal supporter of LeBron James for many years and has praised the NBA star for his talent, work ethic, and leadership both on and off the court.

In conclusion, Jamie Foxx's reaction to LeBron James becoming the all-time leading scorer in the NBA highlights the impact that the basketball star has had not only on the court, but also on the lives of people around the world. LeBron's success and leadership have inspired many, and his place in the record books is well-deserved.
